Hi Caroline — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the early signal.

High level options we can put in front of you for the Wednesday review:

- Option A (time extension): +14 days at the same pilot rate, no price change. Engineering SLA limited to triage support (2x 1-hour sessions).
- Option B (hours swap): convert up to 40% of remaining core pilot compute days into 40 engineering hours (prompt tuning + integration support). We'd treat the hours as a one-off deliverable, no ongoing charge, and capable of being scheduled over 4 weeks.
- Option C (hybrid): +7 days extension + 20 engineering hours. We'll add a modest one-time credit (5% of remaining pilot value) to offset administrative overhead — this is our standard short-run concession.

Procurement / Dan — quick note on finance impact: Option A = no change to invoice schedule; Option B = internal reclassification (compute days swapped to professional services) — total monetary value is approximately the same but booked differently. Option C mixes both and carries a small credit we can absorb for the evaluation.
